hold_text: pr-landing R5 refuses self-landing on src/units/accounts/clients.py and src/web/api/routers/diag.py, both Tier-2 BY PATH, and the guard is right — it cannot certify those paths however read-only the change is, and narrowing the PR is not available because the whole change lives in them. What is needed is a MERGE CLICK, not a re-approval. Read-only diagnostic: one new accessor plus one token-gated GET route; no existing reader, matcher or order path is touched.
why: READ-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC. Adds `account_bybit_raw_closed_pnl` + `GET /api/diag/bybit_raw_closed_pnl` — the RAW Bybit get_closed_pnl records for one symbol and window, un-matched and un-filtered. WHY IT IS NEEDED: every existing question about whether a position closed goes through /v5/position/list, and this repo has been wrong about that endpoint's answer TWICE IN TWO DAYS (BL-20260908-BYBIT-POSITION-PROTECTION-GRADES-A-SYMBOL-OFF-ROWS0-SO-A-HEDGE-BOOK-READS-FLAT-AND-A-LIVE-POSITION-IS-CLOSED, then MI-221). /v5/position/closed-pnl is a SECOND, INDEPENDENT endpoint answering a DIFFERENT question — did the venue book a realised close? — sharing no filter, dedupe, cursor or size field with the position path, so it can confirm or refute a close on its own evidence. It is the ONLY remaining way to test whether trade 5471's exit_reason='sl' is truthful, which MI-221 has flagged as unestablished three times and which no surface can currently ask. THE REDUCTION IT BREAKS: the only existing caller, _bybit_closed_pnl_lookup, is a MATCHER — it scores records against a trade's side, qty, entry price and time, returns the single best and drops the rest into rej_* locals that never leave the function, so 'the venue booked no close', 'it booked one our matcher rejected' and 'we could not ask' are ONE observation to every consumer. This returns every record in venue order and reduces nothing. nextPageCursor is followed AND reported (pages_read / next_page_cursor_seen / pages_truncated) because grep showed nothing in src/ followed it before MI-221, so a truncated page was indistinguishable from a complete one. query_state is three-way and never collapsed — rows_returned / no_rows (the venue answered EMPTY, a real positive measurement) / could_not_look (the call raised, says nothing about the world) — with record_count null, never 0, on the last. Venue strings are preserved verbatim rather than coerced, because coercion manufactures a reading. SAFETY: no existing function's behaviour changes; account_open_positions, account_bybit_open_orders, _bybit_position_protection, _bybit_closed_pnl_lookup and every protective sweep are byte-for-byte untouched, so nothing that decides a close, a re-arm or an order is affected. The route is token-gated and read-only; it places no order and returns no credential material. VALIDATION: 7 assertions in tests/test_bybit_raw_closed_pnl_accessor.py, all executed and passing in-session via a monkeypatch shim because pytest is not installed in this sandbox ('No module named pytest'). Registered in docs/api-tier-policy.md (coverage headline bumped 106 -> 107, computed not asserted) and docs/reference/bot-api-reference.md. Guard state: the three pytest-invoking guards (trainer-capture-watch, artifact-validity, operator-owed) fail in this sandbox ONLY because pytest is absent and cannot be affected by this diff. No order was placed, modified or cancelled on bybit_2 or any account; every venue call in this diff is a GET. DOCUMENT-INDEX.md untouched (no new doc file), so document_index.py --write was not run and remains prohibited.
